description: This file defines the interface MigrateIdMapInterface for managing source-to-destination ID mappings in Drupal's migration system, including methods for saving mappings, retrieving messages, updating, deleting, and lookup operations.

classes.name: MigrateIdMapInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing migration ID mappings, including saving, retrieving, updating, deleting, and lookup operations for source and destination IDs.

methods.name: saveIdMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping from source ID to destination ID with optional status and rollback action.

methods.name: saveMessage
methods.description: Saves a message related to a source record in the migration message table.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Retrieves messages related to source records, optionally filtered by severity.

methods.name: prepareUpdate
methods.description: Prepares the migration for a full update, marking existing content for re-import.

methods.name: processedCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of processed items in the map.

methods.name: importedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of successfully imported items.

methods.name: updateCount
methods.description: Returns the count of items marked as needing update.

methods.name: errorCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items that failed to import.

methods.name: messageCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of messages saved.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes map and message entries for a specific source record, or only messages if specified.

methods.name: deleteDestination
methods.description: Deletes map and message entries for a specific destination record.

methods.name: clearMessages
methods.description: Clears all messages from the migration map.

methods.name: getRowBySource
methods.description: Retrieves a raw row from the map table based on source ID values.

methods.name: getRowByDestination
methods.description: Retrieves a row from the map table based on destination ID values.

methods.name: getRowsNeedingUpdate
methods.description: Retrieves an array of map rows marked as needing update, up to a specified count.

methods.name: lookupSourceId
methods.description: Given a destination ID, returns the corresponding source ID.

methods.name: lookupDestinationIds
methods.description: Given a source ID, returns matching destination IDs; may throw exception if input is invalid.

methods.name: currentDestination
methods.description: Returns the destination ID values of the current record in iteration.

methods.name: currentSource
methods.description: Returns the source ID values of the current record in iteration.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes persistent storage used by the map, such as tables.

methods.name: getQualifiedMapTableName
methods.description: Returns the qualified name of the map table (noted as SQL-specific).

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the migrate message service used for logging messages.

methods.name: setUpdate
methods.description: Marks a record identified by source ID values for update if it exists.
